meta.note: The best-ranked 0.5 degree cells on Earth for each target, by the frozen all-round score (Base weights), and the best-ranked cells in the Indonesian region. Places are given by coordinates only: look each one up before naming it.
caveats: A cell is about 55 km across. The score describes the cell, not a feature inside it.
Scores are low in absolute terms everywhere: read the rank.
"New" means more than 500 km from every site in our list of 28 known analogs. It does not mean nobody has studied the place.
The Indonesian box also holds parts of Malaysia, Brunei, Timor-Leste and Papua New Guinea.
